subject: Solid Waste Ordinance Revisions
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to review proposed updates to Medford's solid waste ordinance under Paper 22-605. The committee approved draft amendments and voted to refer the ordinance out of committee for legal and departmental review.

items.title: Proposed Waste Hauler Ordinance Overview
items.summary: Councilor Collins and department heads presented proposed updates to modernize the solid waste ordinance, establish mandatory recycling requirements, and align municipal hauling standards with state guidelines.

items.title: Ordinance Amendments and Referral
items.summary: The committee approved amendments regarding DPW-provided tonnage standard tables and removing an unused legal section, then voted to refer the paper out of committee to legal counsel, DPW, the Board of Health, and code enforcement.
